description: Reads the journal of Marsell's own planning passes (the weekly plan and the daily passes), newest first: each run's kind (weekly or daily), what started it, when, whether it finished well, its summary, what it was waiting for, its notes, the plan revision it wrote and its cost in tokens. Use it to say what the passes decided and why; what was done in the app is timeline_query, the plan's work itself work_list. Chat turns are not runs here.

n.description: How many of the latest runs, 1 or more; null for every finished run since the last weekly pass, ending with that pass.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: journal_read
title: Journal read
